title: Neer Dosa
description: Delicate, lace-thin rice and coconut crepes from coastal Karnataka that need no fermentation.
steps: Drain the soaked rice and grind with the coconut and a little water to a very fine batter.
Thin with more water to a watery, flowing consistency and stir in the salt.
Heat a non-stick tawa on medium-high and lightly grease with coconut oil.
Stir the batter well, then pour a ladle from a little height, tilting the pan to cover it.
Cover and cook for 1 minute without flipping until the edges lift.
Fold into quarters and serve with coconut chutney or chicken curry.
